status: amendment after observing development-pilot results, before new validation or confirmatory test data

structural_baseline.name: zz_known
structural_baseline.justification: Each ZZ system-bath unitary commutes with system Z, and bath resetting preserves system populations; hence chi_Z=1 at every retention and sequence length
structural_baseline.estimator: F_e=1/2+(chi_X+chi_Y)/4; sample only X and Y, with all shots counted
structural_baseline.evidence: max(abs(chi_Z-1))=0 in the archived 4096-case development dataset
structural_baseline.role: required family-informed DFE and matched-family hybrid comparator in the ZZ benchmark; not available in exchange benchmark without separate proof
structural_baseline.equal_access: all ZZ hybrid priors receive the same family-informed measurements, and may also use this label-acquisition protocol with its cost counted

head_correction: Archived evaluations average nine quantiles, despite manuscript median wording. Preserve mean-of-quantiles results as the reproduction track; report actual median separately if evaluated
norm_correction: The historical FvG estimator is an infidelity-sum heuristic, not a general lower bound; use normalised Choi trace-distance bound only for the channel actually represented
new_test_policy: Do not use development-pilot confidence intervals as confirmation, or use the archived sample for final budget selection and test confirmation
